description: Does this value survive conversion to another numeric or spreadsheet type? Range, precision, leading zeros, E notation — Takes raw JSON literals (as written, so 9007199254740993, 1e400, -0, "007" and 0.10 are judged on their digits, not on a parsed double) and target types (binary64, binary32, int8..int64, uint8..uint64, PostgreSQL numeric(p,s), Arrow decimal128/decimal256, Parquet decimal, Excel cell, pandas int64) and reports for each pair whether the value is exact, lossy (rounded, truncated, leading zeros or sig

pairs.description: Identifier or text values before and after a round trip through another system.

samples.description: Raw JSON scalar literals exactly as written, e.g. 9007199254740993, "007", 1e400, 0.10, null.

targets.description: Target types: float64, float32, int8, int16, int32, int64, uint8, uint16, uint32, uint64, numeric(p,s), decimal128(p,s), decimal256(p,s), parquet-decimal(p,s), excel-number, pandas-int64.

name: lossy-conversion
